description: Schroeder decay and reverberation time (conventions: Reverberation time; ADR 0171).

cases.source: energies 5, 1, 0, 0: 0, 10 log10(1/5), -inf, -inf
h = 0.9^n, 60 samples at 100 Hz, T20 from the exact geometric tail and least squares
h = 0.99^n, 2000 samples: close to 60/(-20 log10 0.99 fs)
h = 0.995^n, T30 (-5 to -35 dB) from the exact tail
h = 0.9^n + 0.3 (0.97)^n: a bent decay, from the exact cross-term tails
h = (0.98 e^(j 0.7))^n: the same curve as the real decay
impulse_response must not be empty
impulse_response must not be all zero
impulse_response must be finite
h = 0.9^n over 10 samples ends near -15 dB, above -25 dB
the curve drops past both levels at n = 1: no sample between them
start_db must be at most 0
stop_db must be below start_db
sample_rate must be positive
stop_db must be finite
case decay_half times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case decay_half times 2^-1000: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case t20_r09 times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case t20_r09 times 2^-1000: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case decay_complex times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case decay_complex times 2^-1000: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
